Fadeno has no published package or released compatibility line yet. This page
is the executable format seed for future migration guidance, not a claim that a
public upgrade exists. A0 will replace the private package identity and assign
version intent before any prerelease.

## Seeded change: remove an unsafe selective revalidation hint

The initial correctness rule is complete current-page revalidation. A selective
`keeps` hint is accepted only when its declared dependency coverage is safe.
When analysis cannot prove that coverage, the structured correction removes
the hint and preserves correct behavior through the complete fallback.

Before:

```json
{
  "schemaVersion": 1,
  "scenario": "resource-keeps-correction",
  "keeps": [
    "tasks",
    "permissions",
    "stable",
    "activity",
    "flaky",
    "not-active"
  ],
  "decisions": [
    "unsafe",
    "unsafe",
    "verified",
    "unsafe",
    "unsafe",
    "not-active"
  ],
  "complete": false,
  "correctnessReads": 5
}
```

After:

```json
{
  "schemaVersion": 1,
  "scenario": "resource-keeps-correction",
  "keeps": [
    "stable"
  ],
  "decisions": [
    "verified"
  ],
  "complete": true,
  "correctnessReads": 4,
  "correctnessReadsRemovedByOptimization": 0
}
```
